name: Appllama
summary: Browsable library of 68,000+ screens from 1,500+ top-grossing iOS apps, with revenue context and an MCP server.
description: A design-research library of iOS app screens: every app is captured screen by screen in journey order (welcome, onboarding, paywall, tabs) with revenue estimates, downloads and ratings. Browse by app, screen, flow or UI element, or search by keyword or meaning; a Pro plan adds unlimited search and a remote MCP server so coding agents can query the library. Open-source agent skills turn what it finds into native-quality mobile screens.
contains: 68,000+ screens from 1,500+ top-grossing iOS apps, new apps added weekly
revenue estimates, downloads, ratings and category rank per app
flows browsable app by app: welcome, onboarding, paywall and more
UI-element galleries with counts (tab bars 14.6K screens, buttons & CTAs 34.9K screens …)
Appllama MCP server for coding agents — 1,500 credits/month on Pro
open-source agent skills: appllama-usage and appllama-app-design-skill
free to browse; Pro for everything (monthly or annual)
